question: Human development spans approximately how many days from fertilisation to birth?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: This is too short. The embryonic and fetal periods together span closer to 38 weeks from fertilisation.
Correct. Human gestation is approximately 266 days from fertilisation (or 280 days from the last menstrual period).
280 days is measured from the last menstrual period (LMP), not from fertilisation. From fertilisation it is ~266 days.
This exceeds the normal range. A post-term pregnancy is defined as ≥42 weeks from LMP.

overallFeedback.feedback: Remember: 266 days from fertilisation (or 280 days from LMP). Post-term is ≥294 days from LMP.
Well done! The 266-day figure from fertilisation is the basis for Naegele's rule and gestational age calculations.
